items.note:
First look at the real method diagram on the left. Figure 1 of Calo and MacLellan marks the teacher's request, the first draft of the system-generated interface, and the teacher's continued modification as A, B, and C respectively. The Chinese explanation only helps to read the pictures and does not pretend to be the author's interface for the operation of this project. Its small-scale comparison involves design efficiency and cannot be translated into student achievement improvements. What I read is the arXiv version. The text is related to the conference. The version relationship is explained on the previous page.
The description of the patent application provides technical ideas for interactive tutoring, content generation and evaluation, and can help list system features that need to be compared; it does not provide the learning effect verification required for this course, nor can it be judged that the current rights are valid based on the public document number. The PNAS study differentiates between exercises with AI and tests without AI to help determine under what conditions the results should be measured. The open experiment comes from Turkish high school mathematics and does not directly answer the teaching conditions of colleges and universities.
A teaching proposal question can be raised from this set of three types of materials: In college courses, if step-by-step prompts give answers relatively directly, can it improve independent answering after removing AI? This is not an identified research gap; it still requires a systematic search for similar work, comparison of prompt conditions, verification of samples and evaluation methods, and a decision by the researcher. There are no truly new experiments, innovative sign-offs, or model-generating research results here.
This round also reads the corrected text presented in the official PMC search index (the directly connected page encounters verification). The correction announced on August 20, 2025 involves the author's unit and is separately registered as version maintenance information. It cannot be regarded as adding a new learning effect study. Quantitative trends also need to fix the database, search terms, document type and time fields, save the full amount and export it to remove duplication by research and patent family, and deal with the disclosure lag; in this example, full database statistics are not performed, and no growth curve is drawn. Example: When there is a questionnaire but lack of scores and usage records, the questions that can be answered will change.
Course Simulation: Public data does not automatically contain required variables; being publicly accessible does not mean that it can be used arbitrarily.
items.note:
For example, if there is only an anonymous questionnaire and lack of grades, usage records, or interpretable chronology, it is not appropriate to directly claim to be able to estimate the causal effect of AI on learning. You can start by researching usage scenarios and feelings, or you can look for other approved data. Questions should be rechecked when study subjects, interventions, and data conditions change. Sample sizes, budgets, and timelines should be calculated based on design, and this page does not fabricate universal sample thresholds or ethical approvals.
